LESSON: WRITING 4.3.1 EYE HAND COORDINATION

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.3: Writing 4.3.1 Eye Hand Coordination
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 4.3.1 Eye Hand Coordination, part of Strand 4 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: How do we form letters of the alphabet?(writing, modeling, painting, fixing puzzles) 2. Which items found in the market can you draw?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 4.3.1 Eye Hand Coordination together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and imagination: originality as learner models the letters of the alphabet.

● Learning to learn: learning independently as learner practice making patterns.

Values:
● Responsibility: persistence as the learner keeps on practicing to perfect the pattern written

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Life skills, self-awareness as the learner appreciates the ability to co-ordinate eyes and hands when making the

pattern

Link to other subjects:

Learner relates modeling different objects and people in the same way they model letters of the alphabet in Creative

Activities
